# PR #3050: Patch: Immersive and Prismatic card versions

Closes #2944

This adds the last two of #2725's ten card versions, both Mythic chases. The server ships and checks them, the client draws them, and the spec gets three new rulings (R2944000, R2944001, R2944002). Every check I ran passes except one web test that timed out once under load (below).

## What changed

**Server**
- Two new registry entries in `crates/server/cosmetics.json`, with offers exactly as the plan gives:
  - **Immersive** (`version-immersive`): 40% of the Legendary and Mythic cards, minus the Dormant Starship. That is 50 cards.
  - **Prismatic** (`version-prismatic`): every Mythic card plus 20% of the Legendary ones. That is 48 cards (30 Mythic, 18 Legendary).
  - Both reach the minimums in every shipped set. Meditative+ and Training Grounds are the lowest, at 2 cards each for both versions.
- `cosmetics.rs` gets the two id constants and a registry test. Every earlier test that slices the registry by position now accounts for the two new entries.
- New API tests:
  - A version a card isn't offered is a 400 and writes nothing, through a pick, a token or the Chase Shard bar.
  - A Legendary token on an offered card gets a 409: tokens only buy up to their own rarity, and none is Mythic.
  - A `"Mythic"` token is a 400.
  - Signature next to either version is a 400.
- `apps/web/src/wire/generated/cosmetics.ts` is regenerated.

**Client**
- **Immersive**:
  - The window draws the picture's backdrop softened, dulled and seen through a sky-blue haze.
  - Over it, a near layer in the window's own shape draws the subject sharp. A Starship in play has no separate subject, so it draws its whole picture hazed.
  - The near layer shifts with the pointer or the device's tilt and slowly breathes (`immersive.ts`). This motion uses one motion slot, the same one Animated uses on that face.
  - It holds still under Reduce motion (setting or system), with Animated foil off, and on lazy grid faces. Faces past the slot limit hold still too.
- **Prismatic**:
  - The picture becomes mirror chrome under a rainbow sheen.
  - On a base face with no border, it also gets a rainbow edge, a chrome bezel and a chrome name banner.
  - The rainbow leaves out yellow and orange and runs there and back, so no two neighbouring colours blend into gold.
  - The edge replaces a Mythic card's normal rainbow edge, which does contain yellow.
- Animated, a foil, a finish and a border all layer on both versions. Signature goes on neither.
- Radiant faces keep the gold frame, their marks and their Radiant paint under both looks.

**Spec**
- New notes `R2944000`, `R2944001`, `R2944002`, and `spec/pending/2944.md`.
- "Amended by" lines on R2725000, R2725001, R2725003 and R2725004.
- §14.2 and §14.12 now list the two versions.
- A `--visual` pending fragment.

## How I tested it
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server`: all pass (lib 208, api 1718, store 670). `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
- The 5 changed web test files: 144/144 pass, including the new `versionLooks5.test.tsx`.
- The harness's web selection (`vitest --project web --changed origin/main …`): 6205 of 6206 pass. The one failure:
  - **`B15 .cf's data-name-tier is nameTier(name) for every catalog card` timed out (5.5 s against a 5 s limit).** It ran while a cargo release build was using the same 4 cores.
  - Re-run alone it passed in 4.6 s.
  - Timed side by side under the same load, an untouched `main` checkout took 7.2–7.6 s and this branch 5.7–6.1 s. So the test sits near its limit on a busy machine either way.
  - I have no CI run showing it fail on `main`, and I left its timeout alone.
- Web and e2e typecheck pass, and eslint on the changed files is clean.
- Cypress component spec `card-versions.cy.tsx`: 17/17 pass, 4 of them new. I looked at the `card-versions-part-5` screenshot: each version's window differs from the normal face on 66–93% of sampled points.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check` pass. `classify --base origin/main --claims` reports Internal (no card plays differently) and exits 0.

## Decisions the issue didn't settle (rejected option in brackets)
- The parallax follows the pointer's position in the viewport [its position on the card: that needs layout reads, and the face ignores pointer events].
- Only the near layer moves [moving the backdrop too would expose the window's edge].
- Immersive's motion and Animated share one slot per face [one slot each].
- Prismatic takes every Mythic card whole [one sampled clause over Legendary and Mythic left Meditative+ with one card, under the per-set minimum].
- Prismatic holds still without Animated, like the other chase versions.
- No `rulesOut` list is added. Signature's existing rule already refuses it, and no other pairing hides, garbles or un-Radiants anything.
- I wrote the patch fragment by hand in Part 4's shape rather than with the generator command. I shortened its player notes to pass the 200-character line limit.
- The issue names a `RADIANT_GOLD_CLEARANCE` constant that doesn't exist. The palette test uses the `RADIANT_GOLD_*` window, as Part 4 did.

## For a person
- iOS sends tilt events only after `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` is called from a tap. The app never asks, so on iOS the pointer or touch drives the parallax. Decide whether a permission prompt is wanted.
- Tracker #2729's refreshed dev-unlock SQL is not part of this PR.

## Worth a second look
- `CardFace.tsx`: the `useArtMotion` slot now covers `artMoves || immersive`, and `motion` is non-null only when the face is also Animated.
- The rainbow edge rule in `cards.css` overrides a Mythic card's rarity edge on base faces with no border.
